subject: LEAP-SECOND directive
notes: kb/Work PB1379 landed. Under OFF (the implied default) the ceiling 86,400 was enforced on every carrier but the floor was not: a COMP-2 / COMP-1 argument of -1.0E-10 was truncated to 0 by the float landing and formatted as midnight by FORMATTED-TIME, FORMATTED-DATETIME and LOCALE-TIME-FROM-SECONDS while COMBINED-DATETIME refused it. The landing now keeps the sign (rounds toward negative infinity), so every carrier takes the out-of-range path.
